 ET Online | 23 Oct 2026, 09:34 PM IST Vice President JD Vance stopped midway through his speech at a Nebraska rally after a woman collapsed. Vance immediately called on his team for a doctor and asked the crowd to pray for her. Watch the moment as the rally is disrupted after a medical emergency emerges, prompting Vance's actions to control the situation.
